statement._text: Good work, [PlayerName]. With their leader dead, the Sand Corsairs are nothing more than disorganized rabble. We'll have the last of them put down by the end of the week at this rate. And most of them are Old Levant too. Two birds with one bullet.
Queen Calixa will no doubt recognize what you did for Levant. Here, your reward for a job well done.
I’ll come with you on the convoy.
Farewell

I'm amazed you got their leader to surrender. He confessed responsibility for everything and his troops disbanded. I don't like leaving these Old Levant troublemakers alive...But I'm not willing to exterminate a surrendering enemy.
What will you do with him now?
Put him on trial, I suppose. It’s barely a formality at this point, though. After all he’s done, he’ll either get the firing squad or be locked in the Hive Prison for the rest of his very short life.
Queen Calixa will no doubt recognize what you did for Levant. Here, your reward for a job well done.
I’ll come with you on the convoy.
Farewell

The leader of these bandits has long since fled the coop. Dammit, we should have moved faster. We may have struck a serious blow to the Corsairs, but as long as their leader is alive, they might be back someday.
Well, you still helped bring the Corsairs down. You’re entitled to your pay. Queen Calixa will no doubt be pleased with your work here, [PlayerName].
I’ll come with you on the convoy.
Farewell
If you need something, bother Yzan. I’m coordinating the troops right now!
Do you have any new information about the Sand Corsairs?
I found out where the Sand Corsairs are hiding. They’re in the Old Levant Ruins. Some Soroboreans are protecting them. I need Yzan’s help. Where is he?
Of course Old Levant has to be connected to this...I think I have an idea what you’re planning. Yzan is by the fountain in the South-East district of Levant. Good luck.
The ruins in the west...That’s the ruins in the small canyon north of the large rock and tree, I think...Hmm...
Do you have any new information about the Sand Corsairs?
No new information yet. I’ll let you know if I find some.
There’s some people in an old tower in the west that are supplying the food to the slums.
The ruins in the west...That’s the ruins in the small canyon north of the large rock and tree, I think...Hmm...
That’s not enough evidence for me to call in the cavalry. Check it out yourself and let me know if you find more.
[PlayerName], good timing, I have work for you. The war is going well, but Levant itself is facing a crisis.

Our situation is getting desperate. The war has cut us off from many of our usual trade routes, and the few that remain are being plundered by bandits. If things do not change soon, we face devastating famine.

The worst are the "Sand Corsairs", as they call themselves. They make no demands, refuse any negotiations, and leave no survivors in their raids. Then even managed to set fire to one of our cactus farms the other day.

Our troops can at least resupply in the field by looting and pillaging the land they take. Our city itself is not so lucky. If these Sand Corsairs are not dealt with, we may win the war only to come home to a city of corpses.
The Corsairs are extremely crafty, none of my agents have been able to locate where they operate from. If you can help us take them down, there will be a very handsome reward.
Do you have any leads I can use?
I’ll look into it if I have time. I can’t make promises.

You're a somewhat recent addition to the city. It's possible the people in the slums might open up to you. I do know that small amounts of food are being smuggled into the slums from the outside, that might be an angle you can exploit.
Come back when you have Quest License 3.
Things are still hectic after the declaration of war, [PlayerName]. I’ll let you know if I need you on the front lines, or on home defense soon enough. Give me a few days to sort this mess out.
